pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Wide courtyard view: low pale portico with broad lead hip roof, domed hall mass behind, columns/pointed arches and door/window rhythm. Adjacent red masonry Treasury and its domes are independent. Trees obscure part of the council roof; full dome inventory is not certified by this view.

pictures.author: Dennis G. Jarvis
pictures.observed: Close portico front: pale mottled shafts, gold collars, stepped capitals, pointed arcades/tie rods, cream walls, tall framed panels and broad pointed gold window screen around an actually open lower door. Ordinary photos guide geometry; painted scenes, inscriptions and exact lattice art are not copied.

pictures.author: Giovanni Dall'Orto
pictures.observed: Courtyard entrance and open return of the broad columned portico, tied into the hall beneath a lead hip roof. Tower base is an independent neighbour. Used to check the attached L-shaped native roof interpretation; trees still hide portions of the roof. No copied pixels or inscription art.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Imperial Council Hall (Kubbealti) with attached L-shaped portico, named OSM way103907772 and roof way335402671, fourth authored member of18 Topkapi Palace structures. Low cream hall, broad hipped lead portico cap, working courtyard and southwest-return pointed arcades, pale marble shafts with stepped capitals/gold collars, recessed large pointed gold-toned window screens and lower open arched doors into enclosed halls. Three compact domed bays are an explicit footprint-led roof reconstruction; exact inaccessible dome/room inventory and profiles remain approximate. Shared neutral rosette screening replaces bespoke lattice artwork. Tower of Justice, adjacent Outer Treasury, Harem and other independent buildings remain host context. No copied painted ceiling scenes, inscriptions/tughra, furniture or visitors.
